steps.why: assemble the files the legacy code expects
run the unmodified legacy code with no network
compare the translation with legacy on every row
feed a failure back for one repair

data.rationale: The process ensures the Python reimplementation matches the legacy behavior by running the original R code, translating, and verifying row‑by‑row parity, then certifying once all tests pass. Fuzzing is added to catch edge cases that may not appear in the standard dataset, providing additional confidence in robustness.
